name: civ_employment
description: C3 demonstration (Checkpoint C, end-to-end scenario 3 'operates a productive asset and compensates another for work'): the band_6x20 population (six factions of 20 founding adults on foraging, stage 3 AI, sandbox) with Civ.Enabled = 1. People build fields and workshops from logs they gathered (C1); an owner who sees a person outside its household may offer work at its asset for goods by gesture; that person decides by its own valuation whether to accept or refuse; a hired worker works the owner's asset under a Work right (the output is the owner's) and the owner may hand over the agreed goods within reach at the end of a shift, or not: unpaid shifts become arrears and the worker may walk out (the contract is suspended, owner Q19), go back, resign or be dismissed. Nothing scripted; no money. 10 sim days.
